U-33002.headline: One-owner hybrid AWD with three logged services
U-33002.body: This one-owner 2024 Toyota RAV4 GX Hybrid AWD is a five-seat SUV for buyers wanting hybrid motoring, all-wheel drive and everyday space. It has travelled 40,446 km, is finished in Urban Rock with black fabric trim, and includes two keys and service books. Three services are logged: two logbook services at Harbourline Toyota Parramatta, plus its Toyota Certified 120-point inspection and pre-delivery service. The inspection passed, including the Toyota hybrid battery health check. A second key was cut and programmed, while a light scratch on the left rear bumper corner was repaired. Tyres measure 5 mm at the front and 7 mm at the rear, with 70% front and 85% rear brake life remaining. Toyota Certified warranty runs until 16 October 2027, alongside new-car warranty balance to 16 February 2029 and roadside assistance. Priced at $42,888 excluding government charges.

U-33006.headline: Ex-demonstrator RAV4 Cruiser Hybrid AWD with 10,807 km
U-33006.body: This ex-demonstrator RAV4 Cruiser Hybrid AWD suits buyers wanting a five-seat SUV with hybrid power, all-wheel drive and a well-equipped cabin. Finished in Urban Rock with black leather-accented trim, it has travelled 10,807 km and has had one logged service: its Toyota Certified 120-point inspection and pre-delivery service at Harbourline Toyota on 21 September 2026 at 10,790 km. The inspection passed, including the hybrid battery health check and 12V battery load test. A small rear-quarter dent was repaired and the scuffed rear cargo liner was replaced. Stone chips on the bonnet leading edge were noted. Toyota Certified warranty runs until 16 October 2027, alongside the balance of new-car warranty to 1 September 2030, with roadside assistance. Priced at $55,990 excluding government charges.

U-33005.headline: Toyota Certified RAV4 Hybrid with four logged services
U-33005.body: This 2023 Toyota RAV4 GXL Hybrid is a five-seat 2WD SUV for drivers seeking efficient everyday transport with practical safety and connectivity features. Finished in Urban Rock with black fabric trim, it has travelled 53,185 km and has four logged services: one at Harbourline Toyota Hornsby, two at Harbourline Toyota Penrith, and its latest Toyota Certified inspection and pre-delivery service at Harbourline. The 120-point inspection passed, with the infotainment software updated and brake fluid flushed. It includes Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, satellite navigation, reversing camera, adaptive cruise control, lane trace assist, pre-collision safety system and blind-spot monitoring. Toyota Certified warranty applies until 16 October 2027, alongside the balance of new-car warranty to 17 September 2028 and roadside assistance. Priced at $44,990 excluding government charges.

U-33010.headline: One-owner RAV4 with five logged services
U-33010.body: This one-owner 2022 Toyota RAV4 GX is a five-seat 2WD petrol SUV for drivers seeking everyday space, safety technology and connected features. Finished in Urban Rock with black fabric trim, it has travelled 69,012 km and is priced at $33,990 excluding government charges. Its history includes five logged services: one at a Toyota dealer in Newcastle, one at Harbourline Toyota Penrith, two at Harbourline Toyota Hornsby, and a Toyota Certified 120-point inspection with pre-delivery service at Harbourline. The inspection passed. A light scratch on the left rear bumper was repaired, and the infotainment software was updated. Toyota Certified warranty runs until 16 October 2027, alongside the balance of new-car warranty until 1 April 2027, with roadside assistance. Features include Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, navigation, reversing camera, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring. Next service is due at 75,000 km or by 19 February 2027.

U-33013.headline: One-owner AWD hybrid with 29,229 km
U-33013.body: This one-owner RAV4 XSE Hybrid AWD suits buyers seeking a five-seat SUV with hybrid power, all-wheel drive and a 1,500 kg braked towing capacity. Finished in Urban Rock with a black interior, it has travelled 29,229 km and is priced at $52,490 excluding government charges.
